name: grand_totals_kpis
purpose: Summarize the overall current performance and benchmark position across the model's main KPIs.
intent: Grand totals for [Sales Actual], [Sales P20], [Sales P50], [Sales P80], [Bills Actual], [Bills P20], [Bills P50], [Bills P80], [Margin Actual %], [Margin P20 %], [Margin P50 %], [Margin P80 %], [Basket Value Actual], [Basket Value P20], [Basket Value P50], [Basket Value P80], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], [Basket Value vs Bench %], [Selected As Of Date], and [Last Updated], no filters, one row.
dax:
EVALUATE
ROW(
    "Sales Actual", [Sales Actual],
    "Sales P20", [Sales P20],
    "Sales P50", [Sales P50],
    "Sales P80", [Sales P80],
    "Bills Actual", [Bills Actual],
    "Bills P20", [Bills P20],
    "Bills P50", [Bills P50],
    "Bills P80", [Bills P80],
    "Margin Actual %", [Margin Actual %],
    "Margin P20 %", [Margin P20 %],
    "Margin P50 %", [Margin P50 %],
    "Margin P80 %", [Margin P80 %],
    "Basket Value Actual", [Basket Value Actual],
    "Basket Value P20", [Basket Value P20],
    "Basket Value P50", [Basket Value P50],
    "Basket Value P80", [Basket Value P80],
    "Sales vs Bench %", [Sales vs Bench %],
    "Bills vs Bench %", [Bills vs Bench %],
    "Margin vs Bench pp", [Margin vs Bench pp],
    "Basket Value vs Bench %", [Basket Value vs Bench %],
    "Selected As Of Date", FORMAT([Selected As Of Date], "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn"),
    "Last Updated", FORMAT([Last Updated], "yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn")
)

name: store_performance_breakdown
purpose: Show which stores are largest and how each store is performing versus benchmark.
intent: Top 15 'Dim_Store'[store_no] rows summarized by [Sales Actual], [Bills Actual], [Margin Actual %], [Basket Value Actual], [Sales vs Bench %], [Bills vs Bench %], [Margin vs Bench pp], and [Basket Value vs Bench %], sorted by [Sales Actual] descending.
dax:
EVALUATE
TOPN(
    15,
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
        'Dim_Store'[store_no],
        "Sales Actual", [Sales Actual],
        "Bills Actual", [Bills Actual],
        "Margin Actual %", [Margin Actual %],
        "Basket Value Actual", [Basket Value Actual],
        "Sales vs Bench %", [Sales vs Bench %],
        "Bills vs Bench %", [Bills vs Bench %],
        "Margin vs Bench pp", [Margin vs Bench pp],
        "Basket Value vs Bench %", [Basket Value vs Bench %]
    ),
    [Sales Actual], DESC
)
